mass.title: Mass analysis
mass.hint: Thousands of matches at once, from each match's summary: no rows are read. Pick a folder of .3dheat files (with its 3dheat-index files, if any).
mass.loaded: {matches} matches: {index} from the index, {cache} cached, {member} from the files, {computed} worked out, {failed} failed · {secs} s · {mb} MB
mass.phases: When in the match (share of its length)
mass.balanceHint: Intervals ~95%; q: false discovery rate against the rest of the split. Click a row to load its matches.
mass.col.name: Name
mass.col.kdTitle: Kills per death, with its ~95% interval
mass.col.winTitle: Share of lives in won matches (rounds), with its Wilson interval
mass.col.qTitle: Benjamini-Hochberg q of K/D and win against the rest
mass.drillTitle: Load these matches into the view, filtered to this
mass.sidesHint: Each side of a map against an even split: matches won where the match names a winner, else lives in won rounds.
mass.chHint.count: Log scale, most in a cell {max}. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.chHint.kd: Kills per death a cell (3 or more), blue low, yellow high. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.chHint.stability: Share of the matches seeing a cell in which it was hot. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.chHint.flow: Presence, with the way it went. Click a place to load the map's matches there.
mass.mapClick: Load the map's matches and look here
mass.insightsHint: Balance, steady hotspots, side advantage, meta shifts and match phases, plus the map detectors on each map's summed grids.
mass.reportLine: {n} findings over {matches} matches, {tests} tests, false discovery rate {fdr}
mass.say.balance.kdUp: {vehicle} trades {ratio}× better than the rest on {where} (K/D {kd}, {units} lives)
mass.say.balance.kdDown: {vehicle} trades {ratio}× worse than the rest on {where} (K/D {kd}, {units} lives)
mass.say.balance.winUp: {vehicle} wins more often than the rest on {where} ({win} of its lives won, odds {ratio}×)
mass.say.balance.winDown: {vehicle} wins less often than the rest on {where} ({win} of its lives won, odds {ratio}× lower)
mass.say.hotspot.stableUp: A steady hotspot on {map}: hot in {share} of the {matches} matches that came by
mass.say.hotspot.stableDown: A place on {map} hot less often than the rest ({share} of {matches} matches)
mass.say.side.winUp: On {map}, side {team} wins {win} of {matches} matches (odds {ratio}× an even split)
mass.say.side.winDown: On {map}, side {team} wins only {win} of {matches} matches (odds {ratio}× below an even split)
mass.say.meta.usageUp: {vehicle} is played more since {since}: {before} → {after} of lives
mass.say.meta.usageDown: {vehicle} is played less since {since}: {before} → {after} of lives
mass.say.phase.peakUp: {event} events crowd into {from}–{to}% of the match length ({ratio}× an even spread)
mass.say.phase.peakDown: {event} events are rare in {from}–{to}% of the match length
mass.places.hint: Places that stand out in the numbers but not in the heat: a large area busy as a whole, an odd kill-death ratio on few events, corridors, height bands, places busy only in one part of the match. Scanned over circles, corridors and grown zones against each match's own rate, at the dispersion the matches show; false discovery rate over every region tried. Click a row to outline it in the view, Load to fly there with its matches.
mass.places.summary: {found} places on {maps} maps, {hidden} hidden; {tests} regions tested, false discovery rate {fdr} · {secs} s
mass.places.none: No place stands out under the false discovery rate with these filters.
mass.places.col.ratioTitle: Rate (or odds) ratio, shrunk by empirical Bayes, with its ~95% interval
mass.places.col.heldTitle: Matches in which it held, of the matches that saw it
mass.places.col.foldsTitle: Of five folds of the matches, how many show it the same way
mass.places.col.obvTitle: How much the place already shows in the plain heat: 0% not at all, 100% plainly. Hidden is under 35%.
mass.places.detail: z {z} · dispersion {phi} · Gi* {g1} / {g2} / {g4} · local Moran {moran} · strongest cell {peak} of the excess · {cells} cells of {cell} · exposure {exposure}
mass.places.heldOut: grown on half the matches, tested on the other half
mass.niches.hint: Groups doing markedly better or worse than the rest: a vehicle on one map, side or in one mode, kills in one sector at one height, a sector in one phase. Beam search over the combinations; matches as clusters; kept when the effect is large, agrees in four of five folds of the matches and holds the false discovery rate. Click a row to refine it.
mass.niches.summary: {found} niches, {tests} groups tested, false discovery rate {fdr}
mass.niches.none: No niche stands out with these filters.
mass.say.place.rateUp: {map}: {event} events at {ratio}× the rate the time spent there predicts ({obs} against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.rateDown: {map}: {event} events at only 1/{ratio} of the rate the time spent there predicts ({obs} against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.rateClassUp: {map}: for {cls}, {event} events at {ratio}× the rate their time there predicts ({obs} against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.rateClassDown: {map}: for {cls}, {event} events at only 1/{ratio} of the rate their time there predicts ({obs} against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.rateBandUp: {map}, {band} above the ground: {event} events at {ratio}× the rate the time spent there predicts ({obs} against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.rateBandDown: {map}, {band} above the ground: {event} events at only 1/{ratio} of the rate the time spent there predicts ({obs} against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.kdUp: {map}: kills against deaths at {ratio}× the odds expected here ({obs} kills against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.kdDown: {map}: kills against deaths at only 1/{ratio} of the odds expected here ({obs} kills against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.kdSideUp: {map}: side {team} trades {ratio}× better here than it does elsewhere ({obs} kills against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.kdSideDown: {map}: side {team} trades {ratio}× worse here than it does elsewhere ({obs} kills against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.kdBandUp: {map}, {band} above the ground: kills against deaths at {ratio}× the odds expected ({obs} kills against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.kdBandDown: {map}, {band} above the ground: kills against deaths at only 1/{ratio} of the odds expected ({obs} kills against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.bandRateUp: {map}: {event} events {band} above the ground run at {ratio}× the matches' rate ({obs} against {exp})
mass.say.place.bandRateDown: {map}: {event} events {band} above the ground run at only 1/{ratio} of the matches' rate ({obs} against {exp})
mass.say.place.bandKdUp: {map}: {band} above the ground, kills against deaths run at {ratio}× the matches' odds ({obs} kills against {exp})
mass.say.place.bandKdDown: {map}: {band} above the ground, kills against deaths run at only 1/{ratio} of the matches' odds ({obs} kills against {exp})
mass.say.place.timeUp: {map}: {event} events crowd into this place in {from}–{to}% of the match only, {ratio}× what the place and the phase predict ({obs} against {exp}; held in {held} matches)
mass.say.place.timeDown: {map}: {event} events are rare in this place in {from}–{to}% of the match, 1/{ratio} of what the place and the phase predict ({obs} against {exp})
mass.say.niche.kdUp: {group}: kills against deaths at {ratio}× the odds of the rest ({value} of kills and deaths are kills, against {base}; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.kdDown: {group}: kills against deaths at only 1/{ratio} of the odds of the rest ({value} of kills and deaths are kills, against {base}; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.winUp: {group}: wins at {ratio}× the odds of the rest ({value} of lives won, against {base}; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.winDown: {group}: wins at only 1/{ratio} of the odds of the rest ({value} of lives won, against {base}; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.deathUp: {group}: dies more often than the rest ({value} of lives end in a death, against {base}; odds {ratio}×; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.deathDown: {group}: survives more often than the rest ({value} of lives end in a death, against {base}; odds 1/{ratio}; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.kphUp: {group}: {value} kills an hour against {base} for the rest ({ratio}×; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.kphDown: {group}: {value} kills an hour against {base} for the rest (1/{ratio}; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.earnUp: {group}: earns {value} a minute against {base} for the rest ({ratio}×; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.earnDown: {group}: earns {value} a minute against {base} for the rest (1/{ratio}; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.deathRateUp: {group}: {value} deaths an hour of presence against {base} elsewhere ({ratio}×; {matches} matches)
mass.say.niche.deathRateDown: {group}: {value} deaths an hour of presence against {base} elsewhere (1/{ratio}; {matches} matches)
